old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a car tire resting on a rough, textured asphalt surface. The tire is partially visible, showing its tread pattern and part of the silver alloy wheel. A small, colorful object comes into view near the base of the tire, partially under it. The object appears to be a toy or a piece of debris, featuring vibrant colors. The object deforms and spreads under the tire's weight, with small colored fragments emerging and scattering on the asphalt surface.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a car tire resting on a rough, textured asphalt surface. The tire is partially visible, showing its tread pattern and part of the silver alloy wheel. As the camera slowly pans to the right, a small, colorful object comes into view. This object appears to be a toy or a piece of debris, featuring vibrant colors like red, green, and yellow. It is positioned near the base of the tire, partially under it. The camera movement is smooth and steady, focusing on the interaction between the tire and the colorful object. The scene remains static otherwise, with no other significant changes or movements occurring.
caption: The video captures a close-up of a car tire pressing on a small clear plastic bottle packed with multicolored water-beads on a concrete surface. The wheel, with silver hubcap tabs and sidewall lettering, translates leftward, sliding the tread over the bottle. The bead-filled body visibly flattens and spreads horizontally, growing from a compact blob into an elongated oval. The gray rounded end on the left becomes progressively flattened and less distinct as the bottle is crushed. Colored droplets and smears appear on the concrete beside the bottle as material is squeezed out. The white bumper at the top-left moves out of view, confirming the car travels relative to a stationary camera. The tire remains in contact with the bottle throughout.
